BattleCampaign/Silkspool.defender: The defender's spawn points spread across the right of the board, one of them standing on {8,6} and one on {8,2}.

BattleCampaign/WieshFight.terrain: Open ground with {4,7} and {8,5} in the top centre and {8,0} in the bottom centre. {10,0} blocks the bottom right corner and {10,6} the top right, with cliffs along the right edge beyond them.
BattleCampaign/WieshFight.attacker: The attacker's spawn points run down the left edge.
BattleCampaign/WieshFight.defender: The defender's spawn points run down the right of the board, two of them on {8,5} and one on {8,0}.

BattleLargeSettlementSiege/LargeSettleme.terrain: Open ground with {10,0} in the bottom right. The defender holds three short stretches of wall: a tower with a wall behind it at the bottom centre, another at the top centre, and a tower with two walls at the middle right. Stairs go up beside each tower, and the walls stand apart with open ground between them.
BattleLargeSettlementSiege/LargeSettleme.attacker: The attacker's spawn points run down the left edge, on open ground in front of the walls.
BattleLargeSettlementSiege/LargeSettleme.defender: The defender's spawn points spread across the centre and the right, six of them on the towers and walls.

BattleSmallSettlementSiege/SmallSettleme.terrain: Open ground on the left, with the defender's towers in the top centre and the bottom centre, stairs up to each from the edge beside it, and a wall between them in the centre. Behind the wall, {9,5} lies in the middle right and {8,0} in the bottom right. The top left and top right corners are closed by {0,6} and {12,6}.
BattleSmallSettlementSiege/SmallSettleme.attacker: The attacker's spawn points spread across the left third, on open ground outside the towers.
BattleSmallSettlementSiege/SmallSettleme.defender: The defender's spawn points fill the centre and the right, two of them on the towers and four on the wall.

BattleTownSiege/TownSiege.terrain: Open ground on the left, and the defender holds the town on the right. A tower stands at the top centre and another at the bottom centre, each flanked by a stretch of moat, with stairs up beside each on the town side. Walls stand in the middle right and the bottom right.
BattleTownSiege/TownSiege.attacker: The attacker's spawn points run down the left edge.
BattleTownSiege/TownSiege.defender: The defender's spawn points spread through the town, one on each tower and four on the walls, two of them siege engine spawns.

BattleTownSiege_Walls/TownSiegeWalls2.terrain: A moat runs from the top left corner down to the bottom centre and is crossed only at {5,4}, the gate in the centre. The defender's walls stand to the right of it: one along the top edge between a tower at its left end and another at the top centre, a short stretch flanked by two towers on the town side at each end of the moat, and another round the bottom right corner with two towers. Stairs go up onto the walls at the top left, the top centre, the top right, the bottom centre and the bottom right.
BattleTownSiege_Walls/TownSiegeWalls2.attacker: The attacker's spawn points run down the left edge, on open ground outside the moat.
BattleTownSiege_Walls/TownSiegeWalls2.defender: The defender's spawn points spread through the town, seven of them on the towers and walls.
